links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance in MRMC study
links.effect: AI assistance improved radiologists' AUC from 0.786 to 0.845 (p < 0.05), reduced interpretation time by 23.7% (5.28 vs. 4.03 min/case); radiologists accepted AI recommendations in 87.14% of cases.
links.quote: A multi-reader, multi-case (MRMC) study demonstrated that AI assistance significantly improved radiologists' diagnostic accuracy (AUC: 0.786 to 0.845; p < 0.05) and reduced interpretation time by 23.7% (5.28 vs. 4.03 minutes/case).

links.outcome: AI performance versus radiologist double-reading in prospective real-world cohort
links.effect: PCN-AI outperformed radiologist double-reading, providing actionable diagnostic benefit to 45.45% of patients (5/11) by identifying missed malignant PCN cases, and reduced clinical workload by 39.3%.
links.quote: In a prospective real-world cohort, PCN-AI outperformed radiologist double-reading, providing actionable diagnostic benefits to 45.45% of patients (5/11) by correctly identifying missed malignant PCN cases, enabling timely intervention, and simultaneously reducing clinical workload by 39.3%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates an AI CT diagnostic tool in an MRMC reader study and a prospective real-world deployment cohort, comparing radiologist performance and workflow metrics with and without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI-assisted radiologist reading vs unassisted reading and double-reading
